api_contracts.purpose: Return stable package identity for smoke acceptance.
api_contracts.error_behavior: Import/runtime failure blocks acceptance.

api_contracts.purpose: Produce a bounded evidence pack from one grounding request.
api_contracts.error_behavior: Invalid requests raise before provider access; provider failures return PROVIDER_ERROR evidence status.

api_contracts.purpose: Return untrusted source candidates for exactly one budgeted provider call.
api_contracts.mutation: provider-defined external behavior; Phase 2 ships SearxngProvider
api_contracts.error_behavior: Provider exceptions are contained by GroundingEngine and fail closed.

api_contracts.purpose: Perform one already-budgeted live JSON search against the configured SearXNG endpoint.
api_contracts.mutation: network GET to operator-configured SearXNG only; no persistent mutation
api_contracts.error_behavior: Transport, redirect, HTTP, content type, response-size, JSON, or result-schema failures raise SearchProviderError.

api_contracts.purpose: Read one bounded application/json response without redirect following.
api_contracts.error_behavior: Fails closed with SearchProviderError on invalid or oversized response.

api_contracts.purpose: Fetch and extract one untrusted result page through a validated public-IP-pinned connection.
api_contracts.mutation: network read only; returns immutable FetchedDocument
api_contracts.error_behavior: Invalid URL/port/DNS target, transport/TLS failure, redirect/non-200 response, disallowed content metadata, overflow, or decode failure raises FetchError without returning partial content.

api_contracts.purpose: Resolve one result-page host and return deduplicated public addresses only when every DNS answer is public.
api_contracts.error_behavior: Resolution failure, empty answers, malformed addresses, or any non-public/multicast answer raises FetchError.

api_contracts.purpose: Chunk bounded fetched documents and return deterministic positive-score BM25 lexical hits.
api_contracts.mutation: in-memory derivation only; no persistent mutation
api_contracts.error_behavior: Empty/oversized query or out-of-policy document/chunk/result bounds raise RetrievalError before returning hits.

api_contracts.purpose: Split one immutable FetchedDocument into bounded overlapping TextChunk values with stable provenance.
api_contracts.error_behavior: Invalid chunk size, overlap, or per-document chunk cap raises RetrievalError.

api_contracts.purpose: Rank in-memory chunks with BM25 and return only positive lexical matches in deterministic order.
api_contracts.error_behavior: Invalid query or result limit raises RetrievalError; no matches returns an empty tuple.

api_contracts.purpose: Provide role-separated dense query and document embeddings without coupling the core to a model vendor or runtime.
api_contracts.mutation: provider-defined compute only; semantic core performs no persistent mutation
api_contracts.error_behavior: Provider exceptions are contained as EmbeddingProviderError and malformed vectors fail closed.

api_contracts.purpose: Chunk bounded fetched documents, obtain validated role-separated embeddings, and return deterministic positive cosine semantic hits.
api_contracts.mutation: in-memory derivation only; no persistent mutation
api_contracts.error_behavior: Invalid request bounds raise RetrievalError; provider/vector defects raise EmbeddingProviderError without partial hits.

api_contracts.purpose: Enforce query/document embedding roles, provider call and batch caps, and strict vector validation.
api_contracts.error_behavior: Too much requested work raises RetrievalError before provider calls; provider/vector defects raise EmbeddingProviderError.

api_contracts.purpose: Run the accepted bounded lexical and semantic retrievers over the same fetched-document corpus and fuse their ranked candidates.
api_contracts.error_behavior: Underlying retrieval/provider errors propagate fail-closed; invalid hybrid result bounds raise RetrievalError.

api_contracts.purpose: Fuse two bounded ranked hit lists with fixed equal-weight reciprocal-rank fusion.
api_contracts.error_behavior: Invalid/non-contiguous ranks, over-limit hit lists, duplicate modality chunk identities, conflicting cross-modality provenance, or invalid output limits raise RetrievalError.

api_contracts.purpose: Return exactly one relevance score per already-bounded hybrid candidate without coupling the core to a concrete reranker model or runtime.
api_contracts.mutation: provider-defined compute only; core performs no persistent mutation
api_contracts.error_behavior: Provider exceptions, unbounded/non-Sequence output, wrong score count, boolean/non-numeric values, or non-finite scores raise RerankProviderError.

api_contracts.purpose: Validate bounded HybridHit candidates, score them once through the injected provider, and return deterministic immutable RerankedHit values.
api_contracts.error_behavior: Invalid query/candidate/rank/result bounds raise RerankingError; provider/output defects raise RerankProviderError without partial results.

api_contracts.purpose: Select exact query-relevant source excerpts from reranked chunks under hard excerpt and total-character budgets.
api_contracts.error_behavior: Invalid query, reranked provenance/rank input, or compression bounds raise RerankingError; no generated/paraphrased fallback is produced.

api_contracts.purpose: Run bounded reranking followed by deterministic extractive context compression.
api_contracts.mutation: none beyond one injected provider compute call
api_contracts.error_behavior: Reranking/provider/compression failures propagate fail-closed without partial context.

api_contracts.purpose: Return exactly one domain-policy authority score in [0,1] per already-bounded source subject without hardcoding authority opinions into the core.
api_contracts.mutation: provider-defined policy compute only; core performs no persistent mutation
api_contracts.error_behavior: Provider exceptions, non-Sequence output, wrong score count, booleans/non-numeric values, non-finite values, or scores outside [0,1] raise AuthorityProviderError.

api_contracts.purpose: Validate bounded source context and obtain one authority score sequence through the injected policy.
api_contracts.mutation: none beyond one bounded provider call
api_contracts.error_behavior: Unbounded/non-Sequence metadata and malformed provider output fail closed without partial authority scores.

api_contracts.purpose: Compute deterministic freshness decay and point-in-time validity from explicit UTC metadata and evaluation time.
api_contracts.error_behavior: Naive/non-UTC/future timestamps, inverted validity windows, unbounded input, or out-of-range freshness horizon raise TemporalScoringError.

api_contracts.purpose: Bind evidence to matching metadata, combine injected authority with freshness and temporal validity, and return stable quality-ranked evidence.
api_contracts.mutation: none beyond one bounded authority provider call
api_contracts.error_behavior: Identity/rank/temporal/provider defects fail closed without partial quality-ranked output.

data_contracts.name: GroundingRequest
invariants: max_search_rounds is validated to 1..2
results_per_call is validated to 1..10
min_evidence_sources is at least 1

data_contracts.name: EvidencePack
invariants: GROUNDED requires minimum unique evidence sources
provider error before sufficiency is PROVIDER_ERROR
budget exhaustion without sufficiency is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE

data_contracts.name: Canonical source URL
invariants: only http and https are accepted
credentials are rejected
fragments do not distinguish sources
duplicate canonical URLs count once

data_contracts.name: Admissible search-result URL
invariants: scheme is http or https
userinfo credentials are forbidden
localhost names are forbidden
ASCII control characters are forbidden
literal IP targets must be globally routable and non-multicast
named hosts are resolved again at fetch time and every answer must be globally routable and non-multicast

data_contracts.name: FetchedDocument
invariants: url has no fragment and uses standard-port HTTP(S)
fetched_from_ip is a validated public IP selected from the fetch-time DNS answer set
media_type and charset passed the explicit allowlist
byte_length is bounded before text extraction
text is untrusted evidence data and not an instruction authority

data_contracts.name: TextChunk
data_contracts.retention: retrieval-call lifetime unless caller retains it
invariants: chunk_id is deterministic for the same source URL, chunk index, and text
source_url preserves FetchedDocument provenance
chunk_index follows deterministic source order
text is bounded by the configured and hard-capped chunk word limit
token_count is derived deterministically from lexical tokenization

data_contracts.name: LexicalHit
data_contracts.retention: retrieval-call lifetime unless caller retains it
invariants: score is positive
rank starts at 1 and follows deterministic BM25 ordering
ties resolve by stable source provenance and chunk identity
hit count never exceeds the configured hard-capped limit

data_contracts.name: SemanticHit
data_contracts.retention: retrieval-call lifetime unless caller retains it
invariants: score is positive cosine similarity
rank starts at 1 and follows deterministic descending semantic score order
equal scores resolve by stable source URL, chunk index, and chunk identity
hit count never exceeds the configured hard-capped result limit
chunk retains the accepted Phase 4 source provenance contract

data_contracts.name: HybridHit
invariants: score is the sum of fixed reciprocal-rank contributions for modalities containing the chunk
rank is contiguous from 1 in final fused order
lexical_rank and semantic_rank preserve source modality rank when present
chunk identity/provenance is identical anywhere the same chunk_id appears
final hit count never exceeds the hard-capped result limit

data_contracts.name: RerankedHit
invariants: rank is contiguous from 1 in descending provider score order
equal provider scores preserve prior HybridHit rank before source provenance ordering
hybrid_rank preserves the incoming hybrid rank
lexical_rank and semantic_rank preserve accepted hybrid provenance
chunk preserves exact immutable source provenance
reranked hit count never exceeds 20

data_contracts.name: EvidenceExcerpt
invariants: text is an exact substring prefix of a selected source sentence and is never generated or paraphrased
source_url, chunk_id, chunk_index, and rerank_rank preserve evidence provenance
one excerpt never exceeds 1200 characters
compressed output never exceeds 8 excerpts or 6000 total excerpt characters

data_contracts.name: EvidenceMetadata
invariants: source_url and chunk_id must match the paired EvidenceExcerpt exactly
retrieved_at and optional published_at/validity timestamps are timezone-aware UTC
retrieved_at and published_at are not later than explicit evaluation now
published_at is not later than retrieved_at
valid_from is not later than valid_until when both exist
source_type and geography are optional context for injected authority policy

data_contracts.name: AuthoritySubject
invariants: contains only source URL, optional source type, and optional geography
does not encode a core-owned authority score

data_contracts.name: EvidenceQualityScore
invariants: authority_score, freshness_score, temporal_validity, and combined score remain in [0,1]
combined score equals authority_score * freshness_score * temporal_validity
rank is contiguous from 1 after deterministic descending combined-score ordering
ties preserve prior rerank rank before stable source/chunk provenance
